documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Issuance Of Corrigendum To The Notice Of Extra Ordinary General Meeting No. 01/2026 27 To Be Held On October 29, 2026.

analysis.summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited reported a 58% year-on-year growth in Q1 FY27 total revenue to INR 853.63 crores, driven by festive occasions and summer wedding demand. EBITDA increased 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores with an EBITDA margin of 11.01%. Profit after tax rose 77% year-on-year to INR 64 crores. The company is pursuing store expansion with planned new locations in Dahod, Gujarat and Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, targeting internal volume growth of approximately 10% for FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: The company targets broad volume growth of around 10% going forward.
guidance.quote: Broadly, we are targeting around 10% volume growth going forward.

guidance.claim: The company is planning for approximately 10% volume growth as its target for both FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

guidance.claim: The company's strategy aims to establish 51 COCO stores, pursuing any further expansion via the franchise route.
guidance.quote: However, our current strategy is to establish 51 COCO stores, while any expansion beyond that target is likely to be pursued through the franchise route.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase its overall studded sales mix to 12% to 15% by March 2028.
guidance.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

guidance.claim: D.P. Abhushan aims to achieve an annual topline growth rate of 25% to 30% by the end of 2030.
guidance.quote: Over the next five years, by the end of 2030, we aim to grow at an annual rate of approximately 25% to 30%.

guidance.claim: Management targets revenue of INR 4,800 crores in FY27 and INR 5,500 crores in FY28.
guidance.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects its EBITDA margin to be between 6% and 6.5% for FY27.
guidance.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

guidance.claim: D.P. Abhushan targets EBITDA margins of 8% to 8.5% by FY30.
guidance.quote: So, we are targeting EBITDA margins to remain between 8% and 8.5%, which is our FY30 vision already in place.

guidance.claim: The company expects 3% to 5% of its revenue to come from the digital/online segment over the next three to five years.
guidance.quote: So, over the long term, in the next three to five years, we are targeting around 3% to 5% of our topline revenue to come from this segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1 FY27 revenue grew 58% year-on-year supported by festive occasions and summer wedding demand.
demand_outlook.quote: We delivered healthy performance in the first quarter, with revenue growing 58% year on year, supported by festive occasions such as Akshaya Tritiya and the onset of the summer wedding season.

demand_outlook.claim: Footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81% in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q1 FY27, footfall at our stores was encouraging, and the footfall-to-conversion ratio stood at 81%, showing strong buying intent and effective in-store engagement.

demand_outlook.claim: Average ticket size in Q1 FY27 was approximately Rs. 1,57,000.
demand_outlook.quote: During the quarter, our average ticket size was approximately Rs. 1,57,000, supported by wedding-led purchases and festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Gold volume growth was approximately 1% to 2% in Q1 FY27 compared to Q1 FY26.
demand_outlook.quote: When we compare Q1 FY27 with Q1 FY26, we have delivered volume growth of approximately 1% to 2%.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding-related purchases accounted for 62% of sales during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: In terms of product category mix, wedding related purchases remained the largest contributor, accounting for 62% of the sales during the quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Customer demand remained healthy across the company's markets during the quarter, supported by consumption-led and investment-led purchases.
demand_outlook.quote: Customer demand remained healthy across our markets during the quarter, supported by both consumption-led and investment-led purchases.

demand_outlook.claim: Participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Following recent government announcements and heightened customer awareness, participation in gold exchange transactions strengthened further, with old gold exchange contributing approximately 25% of total sales in Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Jewellery demand has remained resilient, particularly in wedding-led purchases, despite high gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Even in periods of elevated gold prices, we continue to see jewellery demand remain resilient, especially in wedding-led purchases and relationship-driven markets like ours.

demand_outlook.claim: Wedding jewellery accounts for approximately 60% of D.P. Abhushan's product mix.
demand_outlook.quote: From a product mix perspective, wedding jewellery continues to dominate at ~60%, followed by festival and lightweight jewellery at ~25%, and corporate and other gifting at ~15%, reflecting a well-diversified and demand-aligned portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is observing a consumer shift towards silver demand as gold prices rise.
demand_outlook.quote: Silver demand remains intact. In fact, with gold prices increasing and impacting demand, we are seeing a shift towards silver.

demand_outlook.claim: FY26 growth was driven by value while total volumes declined by around 20%.
demand_outlook.quote: In FY26, most of our growth was driven by value rather than volume. On the volume side, we actually saw a decline of around 20% overall.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finalized a 3,200 sq. ft. COCO model showroom in Dahod to enter the Gujarat market.
capex_expansion.quote: The Dahod showroom will be approximately 3,200 sq. ft. and will mark our strategic entry into the Gujarat market.

capex_expansion.claim: The company finalized a 3,750 sq. ft. showroom in Jabalpur under its first FOCO model.
capex_expansion.quote: Our second showroom, in Jabalpur, will be approximately 3,750 sq. ft. and will be our first Franchisee-Owned Company-Operated model showroom.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is targeting the addition of five to six new stores for the current year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully finalized locations for upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully finalized locations for its upcoming showrooms in Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh and Dahod, Gujarat, with all key agreements, approvals, and necessary formalities completed.

capex_expansion.claim: Fit-out and showroom development activities are progressing at Jabalpur and Dahod, and the stores are expected to become operational shortly.
capex_expansion.quote: Fit-out and showroom development activities are progressing at both locations, and the stores are expected to become operational shortly.

capex_expansion.claim: D.P. Abhushan expanded its showroom network to 12 stores following openings in Dhar and Ratlam.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, the Company further strengthened its footprint in Central India with the successful inauguration of a new s in Dhar, following the expansion in Ratlam earlier in the year, taking the total showroom network to 12.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open three to four COCO stores and one franchise store during the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: For this year, we have planned to open three to four new stores. Additionally, we have already finalized one franchisee and will be opening one franchise store as well.

capex_expansion.claim: D.P. Abhushan aims to scale its store network to approximately 51 stores by 2030.
capex_expansion.quote: Our long-term goal is to reach around 51 stores by 2030.

capex_expansion.claim: Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Chhattisgarh are priority target states for the company's geographical expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: So, Gujarat, Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh is on the priority basis, we are planning to enter.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR 93.99 crores with an EBITDA margin of 11.01%.
margins_costs.quote: At operating level, EBITDA increased by 70% year-on-year to INR93.99 crores in Q1 '27 as compared to INR55 crores in Q1 '26.

margins_costs.claim: In Q4 FY26, EBITDA reached INR 73 crores with an EBITDA margin of 5.45%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at INR73 crores, up 72% YoY. EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 5.45%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin for FY26 improved by 234 basis points over FY25 to reach 7.61%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR309.7 crores, reflecting a strong growth of 77% YoY, with EBITDA margins improving to 7.61%, an expansion of 234 basis points over FY25.

margins_costs.claim: Inventory gains accounted for approximately 28% to 30% of gains in FY26 books.
margins_costs.quote: Approximately 28% to 30% of the inventory gains have been reflected in our books.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects steady-state gross margins to stay around 10% to 11%.
margins_costs.quote: As far as gross margins are concerned, we expect the business to maintain approximately 10% to 11%.

orders_capacity.quote: Our same-store sales growth stood at 52% on an overall basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Annual inventory turnover ratio currently stands between 4.7x and 5.0x.
orders_capacity.quote: Our business currently operates with an inventory turnover ratio of around 4.7x to 5.0x annually, which, in our view, is among the best in the industry.

orders_capacity.claim: D.P. Abhushan's total retail store area reached ~53,650 square feet.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total retail store area stood at ~53,650 sq. ft. supporting our growing scale of operations.

orders_capacity.claim: Store sales productivity averaged ~INR 7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR 339 crores per store for FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: On the productivity front, we delivered an average revenue of ~INR7.6 lakhs per sq. ft. and ~INR339 crores per store for FY26, reflecting strong store-level performance and efficient utilization of retail space.

orders_capacity.claim: Average ticket size was ~INR 1.27 lakhs while inventory turnover stood at ~4.7x in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our average ticket size remained healthy at ~INR1.27 lakhs, indicating balanced demand across categories, while inventory turnover stood at ~4.7x, highlighting efficient inventory management and faster stock rotation.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall store-level conversion rate remained stable between 82% and 83%.
orders_capacity.quote: Our store-level conversion remains strong, with key stores such as Ratlam and Ratlam II delivering higher-than-average conversion levels, while overall conversion has remained largely stable at ~82%–83%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company uses exchange-led procurement, Gold Metal Loans, and commodity exchange hedging to manage working capital and gold price volatility.
capital_allocation.quote: The company continues to leverage exchange led procurement of gold, gold metal loan, and hedging mechanisms on the commodity exchange platform to mitigate gold price volatility, support margin stability, and improve working capital efficiency.

capital_allocation.claim: The company put its QIP plans on hold due to unfavourable market conditions.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we are planning to undertake a QIP; however, we have currently put it on hold as market conditions are not favourable.

capital_allocation.claim: Store expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 will be funded via internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: As far as our expansion plans for FY27 and FY28 are concerned, they will be executed through internal accruals as well.

capital_allocation.claim: D.P. Abhushan has no plans for long-term borrowings as 90% to 95% of investment is in inventory.
capital_allocation.quote: No, we have not yet planned for any long-term borrowings. If you look at our balance sheet, more than 90% to 95% of our investment is in inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has adopted Gold Metal Loans and hedging mechanisms to safeguard inventory against price volatility.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has also strengthened its risk management framework through Proactive adoption of Gold Metal Loans (GML) and hedging mechanisms to manage volatility and maintain margin stability, effectively safeguarding inventory against gold price volatility.

risks_headwinds.claim: The gold import duty increase from 6% to 15% in May 2026 introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the recent government announcement and increase in gold import duty from 6% to 15% in May 2026 has introduced near-term cost and demand sensitivity, the long-term fundamentals of the sector remain intact, supported by India’s cultural affinity for gold, wedding and festive led demand, rising formalisation, omnichannel adoption.

risks_headwinds.claim: Customs duty changes and Prime Minister's remarks on spending practices created short-term sentiment discussions in the industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: Over the past few weeks, there has also been industry-wide discussion around the recent customs duty changes and the Honourable Prime Minister’s comments regarding mindful spending practices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gold price volatility has caused recent disruptions in consumer sentiment.
risks_headwinds.quote: Recently, we have seen some impact due to fluctuations in gold prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Seasonality affects demand, with June and July typically experiencing lower buying activity post-wedding season.
risks_headwinds.quote: That said, demand can be temporarily affected by seasonality. For instance, the wedding season has recently concluded, and months like June and July typically see relatively lower demand.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets approximately 10% volume growth for both FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Internally, we are planning for approximately 10% volume growth, and that remains our broad target for both FY27 and FY28.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets adding approximately five to six new stores during the year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year as well, we are targeting the addition of approximately five to six new stores.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets increasing the overall studded mix to 12% to 15% by March 2028.
management_commitments.quote: And we have targeted by March ‘28, we would like to increase up to 12% to 15% on an overall basis.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its footprint in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities across Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Gujarat, and Maharashtra in the upcoming 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: Plans to Expand in Tier 2 & 3 Cities in Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh , Gujarat and Maharashtra in upcoming 5 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins of 6% to 6.5% for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Our margin guidance will be around 6% to 6.5%, EBITDA margin.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets revenue of INR 4,800 crores in FY27 and INR 5,500 crores in FY28.
management_commitments.quote: So FY27 and FY28, the revenue we are planning around like 20%, 25% growth. So INR4,800 crores, and the next year will be INR5,500 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The company is planning to open a store in Jaipur in the next one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: We are targeting Jaipur in the next one to two years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
